study_area.volume: Sanborn St. Louis Vol. 12 (1938 edition and the 1938-Jun 1950 revision; same sheet numbers 1-74)
study_area.boundaries_today: Carondelet: Eichelberger St (NE), Mississippi River (SE), River Des Peres (SW), S. Grand Blvd / I-55 (NW). Patch: south of Robert Ave and east of Alabama Ave to the city limits; historically part of the town of Carondelet.

west_of_grand.note: Holly Hills, Boulevard Heights, Carondelet Park, St. Matthew's and Sts. Peter & Paul cemeteries. In the volume and the budget, but outside Carondelet proper; process last.

study_area.sheet_assignment: Approximate, from the 1938 key map (sheet 0). The Fire Limits line and the Missouri Pacific R.R. roughly follow S. Grand; Robert Ave splits Carondelet from Patch.

edition_notes.1938: 77 images: title, index, key map, sheets 1-74.
edition_notes.1950: 78 images: cover, title, 2 index pages, key map, sheets 1-74 except sheet 11 (not in the scan). Paste-over revisions on the 1938 base, so each sheet mixes 1938 and later corrections.

other_years.1908: Vol. 8, 1908 (sanborn04858_011, digitized): sheets ~47-106 cover riverfront Carondelet from Bates to the River Des Peres. A third, pre-car map year for the same streets (Phase 3).
other_years.1916: Vol. 12, 1916 (sanborn04858_015): does NOT match. It covers Dutchtown / Gravois / Morgan Ford; only sheets 47-50 touch Carondelet's west edge (Loughborough-Robert, west of Grand).

editions.note: Vol. 8, 1908, at 50 ft to the inch. Sheets 41-106 cover Carondelet and Patch (trim to those overlapping the 1938 coverage once placed); -0000 is the key map.
